name: golang-best-practices
title_zh: golangci-lint 不闭嘴就不准合代码的 G
tagline_zh: 写 Go 最怕 review 时被揪着命名、并发、错误处理来回改。它把社区十年踩坑经验焊进你的提交前检查。
tagline_en: Tired of review loops over naming, concurrency, error handling? This bakes Go community wisdom into your.
desc_en: Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring Go code in this repository — covers idiomatic error handling, naming, package/API design, concurrency, context usage, testing, and running golangci-lint before considering Go work done.
why_zh: 不是又一份风格清单，而是把 golangci-lint 的规则和 Go 官方最佳实践绑成同一道闸门。
why_en: Not another style list—it welds golangci-lint rules to official Go best practices as one gate, so humans only argue about what.
limit_zh: 只认 Go 语言，且仓库里得有 golangci-lint 配置；它管代码规范与常见反模式。
limit_en: Go only, needs golangci-lint config in repo; covers style & common anti-patterns, not architecture or business-logic correctness.
title_en: Go code gatekeeper that won't let you merge until.
